description: Declarative product-level branding profile. Every row below is a globals key/value pair
taken from Part 1 of the string replacement map, cross-checked against the canonical
inventory in docs/rebranding.md sections 9.1 and 9.4 to 9.7.
This file is DATA. It is applied by skyeagle-branding:apply-profile and by nothing else.
Every key must be a case of BrandingGlobalKey or SuppressionGlobalKey; every value must fit
value_ar records the Arabic string Part 1 supplies for a row. globals holds one value per
key, so value_ar is documentation for the translation workstream except where a key exists
to carry it (saas_branding_product_name_ar). It is never written to the English row.

omitted.reason: Tenant data, not product configuration. Part 1 says 'leave blank at product level'. Writing a blank would clobber a tenant's configured number on every apply.
Tenant-specific endpoint under the Q12 subdomain-per-tenant scheme. Provisioning owns it.
Portal enablement is a provisioning decision, not branding (audit finding CR-4). Branding must work whether the portal is on or off. Deliberately absent from BrandingGlobalKey for the same reason.
'Your Clinic Name Here' lives in the facility table. Tenant data, not product configuration, and not a global.

Materialiser-owned. skyeagle-branding:materialise writes them; a declarative profile must never forge a revision or a materialisation timestamp. NOTE the seven saas_branding_* globals split into two groups, and only this group is off-limits here: MATERIALISER-OWNED = saas_branding_revision, saas_branding_materialised_at, saas_branding_tokens_light, saas_branding_tokens_dark (runtime state, per-tenant, never declarative). PRODUCT-LEVEL and legitimately profile-writable = saas_branding_product_name_ar (the Arabic product name is the same for every tenant, exactly like openemr_name). TENANT-LEVEL and set by provisioning, not by this profile = saas_branding_tenant_display_name, saas_branding_tenant_display_name_ar. This split was made explicit on 2026-08-10 after an audit pass (docs/RebrandingBugs.md RB-16) misread the sentence above as covering all seven keys and reported a contradiction that does not exist.
